about_the_game:
A Gummy bear that doesn’t want to do anything—
With a super lazy voice, she’ll melt away with you.

When you want to sleep, she’s already half-asleep.
When you want to slack off, she’s already waiting for you in bed.
This isn’t your usual ASMR.
This is the audio version of “I don’t want to try anymore.”

📦 Contents include:

✨ Gummy Bear’s yawns, the sound of her rolling over, and her sleepy mumbling

✨ “Hey… don’t turn it off… I still want to talk to you…”

✨ “Come closer… I’m too lazy to talk any louder… hehe…”

✨ “I don’t care if you go to work or not… I just want to stay glued to your ear…”

✨ High-quality stereo recording, as if an entire piece of jelly is pressed right up against your headphones.

No responsibilities, no deadlines, no pressure.
Just soft breaths, a fluffy, spoiled voice,
and maybe… a little desire to be held tight.
